title: Security Protocol
content:
Security is baked into the Photon core. We utilize advanced header sanitization and runtime protection to ensure your engine remains stable under adversarial conditions.

Hardened Headers

Photon automatically handles common security headers with minimal overhead:

  • Content-Security-Policy: Strict by default.
  • X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
  • Strict-Transport-Security: Enforced in production.

Security middlewares in Photon are pre-compiled to avoid re-parsing overhead during high-volume DDoS mitigation scenarios.
